notes: Describes the claim fields used by this agent's sample data.
Monetary amounts are stored as decimal strings in USD, which keeps the fixtures readable and the arithmetic deterministic.

expected_reimbursement_amount.description: Expected payment from the insurance company. Used in practice management systems (PMS) to compare with actual payments during reconciliation.

allowed_max_amount.description: The maximum amount an in-network insurer will pay for a covered service, which dictates the expected payment.

net_pay.description: The finalized amount the insurer paid for the claim.

net_fee.description: In some systems, the fee schedule rate adjusted for expected contractual obligations.
